instruction: Use BRL-CAD to read the STEP input file(s) from the Desktop path(s): /home/user/Desktop/branch_pipe.step, /home/user/Desktop/main_pipe.step. Read /home/user/Desktop/main_pipe.step and /home/user/Desktop/branch_pipe.step. Place two branch pipes so they intersect the main pipe at X=30 mm and X=70 mm, with both branch axes along Y and intersecting the main pipe centerline. Fuse all three pipes. Then cut a through hole of diameter 12 mm along the main pipe axis through the full main pipe length. Export exactly one STL mesh named /home/user/Desktop/out.stl to the output folder.
